theme: 美股三大报表交叉：沃尔玛最新财年利润表切入，联动资产负债表算ROA、现金流量表算自由现金流（财年FY口径），话题切换至可口可乐资产负债表
question: 这个财年它最终落到净利润有多少？
first_sql: SELECT asm.CSNAME AS `股票名称`, asm.COMB_SYMBOL AS `股票代码`, vc.F001D AS `财政周期结束日期`, vc.F004N AS `财政期间长度-日`, vc.F005V AS `货币单位`, ROUND(vc.F048N/100, 3) AS `营业收入(亿美元)`, ROUND(vc.F032N/100, 3) AS `净利润(亿美元)` FROM AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN asm JOIN VIEW_COM3103_CUM vc ON asm.FIU_ID = vc.FIU_ID WHERE asm.COMB_SYMBOL = 'WMT.US' AND vc.F003V = 'FY' AND vc.F032N IS NOT NULL AND vc.F001D = (SELECT MAX(F001D) FROM VIEW_COM3103_CUM WHERE FIU_ID = asm.FIU_ID AND F003V = 'FY' AND F032N IS NOT NULL)
final_sql: SELECT asm.CSNAME AS `股票名称`, asm.COMB_SYMBOL AS `股票代码`, vc.F001D AS `财政周期结束日期`, vc.F004N AS `财政期间长度-日`, vc.F005V AS `货币单位`, ROUND(vc.F048N/100, 3) AS `营业收入(亿美元)`, ROUND(vc.F032N/100, 3) AS `净利润(亿美元)` FROM AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN asm JOIN VIEW_COM3103_CUM vc ON asm.FIU_ID = vc.FIU_ID WHERE asm.COMB_SYMBOL = 'WMT.US' AND vc.F003V = 'FY' AND vc.F032N IS NOT NULL AND vc.F001D = (SELECT MAX(F001D) FROM VIEW_COM3103_CUM WHERE FIU_ID = asm.FIU_ID AND F003V = 'FY' AND F032N IS NOT NULL)
